text.am: ሰላም! ዛሬ የመጀመሪያውን Python variable እንማራለን።
text.en: Hello! Today we learn our first Python variable.

review.note: Seed content from demo-lesson-script.md. Amharic not yet checked by a native speaker.

text.am: ይህ ትምህርት ሦስት ደቂቃ ብቻ ይወስዳል።
text.en: This lesson takes only three minutes.

review.note: Seed content from demo-lesson-script.md. Amharic not yet checked by a native speaker.

text.am: Variable ማለት ለአንድ ዋጋ የምንሰጠው ስም ነው።
text.en: A variable is a name we give to a value.

review.note: Seed content from demo-lesson-script.md. Amharic not yet checked by a native speaker.

text.am: ልክ በሳጥን ላይ እንደምንለጥፈው ስያሜ ማለት ነው።
text.en: It is like a label stuck on a box.

review.note: Seed content from demo-lesson-script.md. Amharic not yet checked by a native speaker.

text.am: ሳጥኑ ውስጥ ዋጋ አለ፣ ስያሜው ደግሞ ስሙ ነው። ኮምፒውተሩ ይህን ስም ሲያይ ውስጡ ያለውን ዋጋ ያስታውሳል።
text.en: The box holds a value and the label is the name. When the computer sees the name, it remembers the value inside.

review.note: Seed content from demo-lesson-script.md. Amharic not yet checked by a native speaker.

text.am: አሁን እንጻፍ። መጀመሪያ ስሙን እንጽፋለን፦ age።
text.en: Now let's write it. First the name: age.

review.note: Seed content from demo-lesson-script.md. Amharic not yet checked by a native speaker.

text.am: ከዚያ equals sign፣ እና ከዚያ ዋጋው፦ ሃያ አራት።
text.en: Then the equals sign, then the value: twenty-four.

review.note: Seed content from demo-lesson-script.md. Amharic not yet checked by a native speaker.

text.am: ስለዚህ age ማለት ሃያ አራት ነው። ይህ ዋጋ ቁጥር ስለሆነ integer ይባላል።
text.en: So age means twenty-four. Because it is a number, it is called an integer.

review.note: Seed content from demo-lesson-script.md. Amharic not yet checked by a native speaker.

text.am: አሁን ዋጋውን እንይ። print ብለን፣ በቅንፍ ውስጥ ስሙን እንጽፋለን፦ age።
text.en: Now let's see the value. We write print and, in brackets, the name: age.

review.note: Seed content from demo-lesson-script.md. Amharic not yet checked by a native speaker.
Seed content from demo-lesson-script.md. Amharic not yet checked by a native speaker.

text.am: ስምም በ variable ማስቀመጥ ይቻላል። ጽሑፍ በ quotation marks ውስጥ ይገባል፤ ይህ string ይባላል።
text.en: We can also store a name in a variable. Text goes inside quotation marks; this is called a string.

review.note: Seed content from demo-lesson-script.md. Amharic not yet checked by a native speaker.

text.am: የ variable ስም በቁጥር መጀመር የለበትም፣ እና ክፍት ቦታ መያዝ የለበትም። ትልቅና ትንሽ ፊደል ይለያያል።
text.en: A variable name must not start with a number or contain spaces. Capital and small letters are different.

review.note: Seed content from demo-lesson-script.md. Amharic not yet checked by a native speaker.

text.am: ባጭሩ፦ variable ለአንድ ዋጋ የሚሰጥ ስም ነው። age ከ equals ሃያ አራት ዋጋውን ያስቀምጣል፣ print ደግሞ ያሳያል።
text.en: In short: a variable is a name for a value. age = 24 stores the value, and print shows it.

review.note: Seed content from demo-lesson-script.md. Amharic not yet checked by a native speaker.

text.am: አሁን አንድ ጥያቄ፦ age equals ሃያ አራት ምን ያደርጋል?
text.en: Now one question: what does age = 24 do?

review.note: Seed content from demo-lesson-script.md. Amharic not yet checked by a native speaker.

text.am: ፕሮግራሙ ይሰራል። ተርሚናሉ ላይ ቁጥር ሃያ አራት ይታያል። በ Variables ፓነል ውስጥ አዲስ ረድፍ ይታያል፦ age፣ integer፣ ሃያ አራት። አረንጓዴ ማስታወቂያ ያለ ስህተት መጠናቀቁን ይናገራል።
text.en: The program runs. The terminal shows the number 24. A new row in the Variables panel reads: age, integer, 24. A green banner says the run finished with no errors.

review.note: Seed content from demo-lesson-script.md. Amharic not yet checked by a native speaker.

definition.en: A name we give to a value so the computer can remember it. In age = 24, age is the variable.
definition.am: ኮምፒውተሩ እንዲያስታውሰው ለአንድ ዋጋ የምንሰጠው ስም ነው። በ age = 24 ውስጥ age variable ነው።
